{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your Maximum Vigor is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0" * 100|%|]{/c}, and killing an enemy grants you {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} Vigor. 

While you have {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}, your new Poisoning effects last {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1" * 100|%|]{/c} longer. {if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
